questions.question: A sentence is a group of words that expresses a complete – [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: Sentence হলো কতগুলো শব্দের সমষ্টি যা একটি সম্পূর্ণ ধারণা বা thought প্রকাশ করে.

questions.explanation: Sentence-এ যার সম্পর্কে কিছু বলা হয় বা যে কাজটি করে, তাকে subject বা কর্তা বলা হয়.

questions.explanation: Subject সম্পর্কে যা কিছু বলা হয়, তাকেই predicate বা বিধেয় বলা হয়.

questions.question: The predicate of a sentence is – [SABAS][]
options: A person about whom something is said.
questions.explanation: Predicate হলো Sentence-এর সেই অংশ যা subject সম্পর্কে কিছু বলে.

questions.question: When we write sentence – [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: ইংরেজি Sentence-এর গঠন অনুযায়ী সাধারণত subject প্রথমে বসে.

questions.question: Because every sentence must contain a subject and a verb, how many essential part (s) every sentence have? [SABAS][]
options: three is on hard and fast rule

questions.question: A sentence must have a – [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: একটি সার্থক Sentence-এর প্রধান দুটি অংশ হলো subject এবং predicate, আর predicate-এ অবশ্যই একটি finite verb থাকতে হবে.

questions.question: An assertive sentence means: [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: Assertive sentence হলো একটি সাধারণ বর্ণনা বা simple statement.

questions.question: The boy has a book. (What kind of sentence it is?) [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: The boy has a book বাক্যটি দিয়ে একটি সাধারণ বর্ণনা দেওয়া হয়েছে, তাই এটি Assertive sentence.

questions.question: ‘The wind is unfavourable.’ What kind of sentence this? [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: এই বাক্যটি একটি সাধারণ বিবৃতি বা simple statement প্রকাশ করছে, তাই এটি একটি Assertive sentence.

questions.question: Only Rina can do this sum. (Negative) [SABAS][]
options: Only Rina cannot do this sum.
None but Rina can do this sum
Anyone but Rina can do this sum.
questions.explanation: Affirmative বাক্যে ব্যক্তিবাচক Noun-এর আগে 'Only' থাকলে Negative করার সময় 'None but' বসে।

questions.question: None but one student was absent. Which is affirmative? [SABAS][]
options: Only one student was always absent
questions.explanation: Negative বাক্যে 'None but' থাকলে Affirmative করার সময় এর পরিবর্তে 'Only' বসে।

questions.question: Choose the correct negative sentence. ‘Only a rogue can act thus.’ [SABAS][]
options: Only but a rogue can act thus.
No one but a rogue can act thus.
None but a rogue can act thus.
No one can act thus but a rogue.
questions.explanation: ব্যক্তিবাচক Noun (rogue)-কে qualify করায় 'Only'-এর পরিবর্তে 'None but' ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।

questions.question: ‘A child likes only sweets’ – Negative form of this sentence is- [SABAS][]
options: A child likes nothing but sweets
A child likes none but sweets
A child likes not more sweets
questions.explanation: বস্তুবাচক Noun (sweets)-কে qualify করায় 'Only'-এর পরিবর্তে 'nothing but' বসেছে।

questions.question: He has only a few books. [SABAS][]
options: He does not but a few books.
He is nothing though a few books.
He has nothing but a few books.
He does not possess a few books.
questions.explanation: বস্তুবাচক Noun-এর সাথে 'only' থাকলে Negative করার সময় 'nothing but' বসে।

questions.question: Priyom is only six. (Negative) [SABAS][]
options: Priyom is not more than six.
questions.explanation: সংখ্যাবাচক শব্দ (six)-কে qualify করায় 'Only'-এর পরিবর্তে 'not more than' ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।

questions.question: He is only five. (Negative) [SABAS][]
options: He is not less than five.
questions.explanation: সংখ্যাবাচক শব্দের ক্ষেত্রে 'Only'-এর পরিবর্তে 'not more than' বা 'not less than' ব্যবহার করা যায়।

questions.question: I must do this. (Make it negative) [SABAS][]
options: I must not but do this.
questions.explanation: Affirmative-এ 'must' থাকলে Negative-এ 'cannot help + verb+ing' বা 'cannot but + base form of verb' বসে।

questions.question: I must go there. (Negative) [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: must' এর পরিবর্তে 'cannot but' এবং এরপর verb-এর base form (go) বসেছে।

questions.question: I must do it. (Make it negative) [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: Affirmative বাক্যে 'must' থাকলে Negative করার সময় 'cannot but' ব্যবহার করতে হয়।

questions.question: ‘I cannot help listening to him.’ Show in form using ‘but’. [SABAS][]
options: I cannot but listen to him.
I but can listen to him.
questions.explanation: Cannot help + verb+ing এর পরিবর্তে cannot but + base form of verb (listen) বসে।

questions.question: I cannot but go there. (Use ‘help’ in place of ‘but’) [SABAS][]
options: I cannot help in going there.
I cannot help to go there.
I cannot help for going there
questions.explanation: Cannot but-এর পরিবর্তে 'cannot help' বসালে পরের verb-এর সাথে 'ing' যুক্ত করতে হয়।

questions.question: None can escape his fate. Choose the correct affirmative of this sentence. [SABAS][]
options: Everyone must submit to his fate.
questions.explanation: Negative (None) কে Affirmative করার সময় Everyone এবং বিপরীতার্থক শব্দ বা ভাবের সংগতি রাখতে হয়।

questions.question: Everybody should admit the truth. (Make it negative without changing its meaning) [SABAS][]
options: Everybody should not admit the truth.
questions.explanation: Everybody-র পরিবর্তে Nobody এবং admit-এর বিপরীত শব্দ deny ব্যবহার করে অর্থ ঠিক রাখা হয়েছে।

questions.question: Nobody likes a liar. The affirmative form of the sentence is --- [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: Nobody-র পরিবর্তে Everybody এবং likes-এর বিপরীত শব্দ hates ব্যবহার করে অর্থ অপরিবর্তিত রাখা হয়েছে।

questions.question: Every rose has a thorn. Make it negative. [SABAS][]
options: There is no rose without thorn.
questions.explanation: Every + noun থাকলে 'There is no + noun + without' গঠন অনুসরণ করে negative করা হয়।

questions.question: ‘Every mother loves her child’. Make it negative. [SABAS][]
options: Every mother does not love her child.
Every mother doesn’t love her child.
There is no mother but loves her child.
questions.explanation: Every + noun + verb থাকলে 'There is no + noun + but + verb' ব্যবহার করে negative করা হয়।

questions.question: The negative form of the sentence,“It always pours when it rains” is- [SABAS][]
options: It never pours when it does not rain
It always does not pours when is does not rain
It never rains but it pours
It never pours but it rains
questions.explanation: প্রবাদ বা বিশেষ বাক্যের ক্ষেত্রে 'It never rains but it pours' গঠনটি নেতিবাচক ভাব প্রকাশে সঠিক।

questions.question: Everyone always remembers him. (Make it negative) [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: Always-এর বিপরীত 'never' এবং remembers-এর বিপরীত 'forgets' ব্যবহার করে negative করা হয়েছে।

questions.question: We always honour our teacher. (Make it negative) [SABAS][]
options: We should not dishonour our teacher.
We shall not honour our teacher.
questions.explanation: Always-এর পরিবর্তে 'never' এবং মূল শব্দের বিপরীত শব্দ (honour → dishonour) ব্যবহার করে negative করা হয়েছে।

questions.question: Tuhin was never late. (Make it affirmative): [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: Never-এর পরিবর্তে 'always' এবং late-এর বিপরীত শব্দ 'punctual' ব্যবহার করা হয়েছে।

questions.question: Which one is the right form of negative sentence without any change of this affirmative sentence? ‘He is sometimes foolish’ [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: Sometimes-এর পরিবর্তে 'not always' এবং foolish-এর বিপরীত শব্দ 'wise' ব্যবহার করা হয়েছে।

questions.question: Akhi missed the train (Negative). [SABAS][]
options: Akhi did not catch the train
Akhi did not get the train
Akhi did not get into the train
Akhi does not get on the train
questions.explanation: Affirmative বাক্যে Verb-এর past form (missed) থাকলে Negative করার সময় 'did not' এবং verb-এর base form (catch) বসে।

questions.question: He acted wisely. (Make it Negative) [SABAS][]
options: He did not but act wisely.
questions.explanation: Verb-কে negative করে এবং Adverb (wisely) এর বিপরীতার্থক শব্দ (foolishly) ব্যবহার করে negative করা হয়েছে।

questions.question: As soon as I left the place he went away. – Which is negative? [SABAS][]
options: No sooner I had left the place he went away.
As soon as I did not leave the place he went away.
As soon as I do not leave the place he went away.
No sooner had I left the place than he went away.
questions.explanation: As soon as-এর পরিবর্তে 'No sooner had... than' বসে এবং verb-এর past participle form (left) ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.question: As soon as the teacher enters the classroom, the students stand up. (Negative) [SABAS][]
options: No sooner does the teacher enter the classroom than the students stand up.
No sooner the teacher enters the classroom than the students stand up.
No sooner had the teacher entered the classroom than the students stood up.
The students stood up as the teacher entered the classroom.
questions.explanation: As soon as (present tense) এর পরিবর্তে 'No sooner does... than' বসে এবং verb-এর base form (enter) ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.question: He is the best player. (Negative) [SABAS][]
options: No other player is as better as he
No other player is as good as he
No other player is as best as he
No other player is considered as best as he
questions.explanation: Superlative degree-কে positive degree-তে পরিবর্তন করে negative করা হয়েছে (No other + noun + verb + as + positive form + as + pronoun)।

questions.question: ‘He is the best boy in the class.’-Make it negative. [SABAS][]
options: No other boy in the class is so good as he.
None other than he is a good boy in the class.
He is not the best boy in the class.
He is nothing but the best boy in the class.
questions.explanation: Superlative-কে positive degree-তে রূপান্তর করে negative করা হয়েছে (No other + object + verb + so/as + positive form + as + subject)।

questions.question: The negative form of the sentence “Neela is taller than Bushra.” [SABAS][]
options: Bushra is not so tall as Neela.
Bushra is not taller than Neela.
Neela is not shorter than Bushra.
questions.explanation: Comparative degree-কে positive degree-তে পরিবর্তন করে negative করা হয়েছে (Object + verb + not so + positive form + as + subject)।

questions.question: Money is sweeter than honey. (Negative) [SABAS][]
options: Honey is not so sweet as money
Nothing as as sweet as money and honey
Money is not so sweet as honey
Honey is not sweeter than money
questions.explanation: Comparative-কে positive degree-তে পরিবর্তন করে negative করা হয়েছে (Object + verb + not so + positive form + as + subject)।

questions.question: He is greater than I. Negative form of this affirmative sentence is - [SABAS][]
options: I am not as great as he
He is no greater than I
He is so great as I
I am not greater than he
questions.explanation: Comparative-কে positive degree-তে রূপান্তর করে negative করা হয়েছে। 'Greater than' এর বিপরীত কাঠামো 'not as great as' ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।

questions.question: Which one is an interrogative sentence? [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: যে বাক্যে প্রশ্ন জিজ্ঞাসা করা হয় এবং শেষে প্রশ্নবোধক চিহ্ন (?) থাকে, তাকে Interrogative sentence বলে।

questions.question: Choose the correct interrogative. [SABAS][]
options: Will you go to the park?
You will go to the park?
Will go you to the park?
Go will you to the park?
questions.explanation: Interrogative sentence-এ অক্সিলারি ভার্ব (Will) সাবজেক্টের (you) আগে বসে।

questions.question: Choose the correct interrogative form of the following sentence. I do the work. [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: Present Indefinite Tense-এর ক্ষেত্রে subject-এর আগে 'Do' বা 'Does' বসে এবং main verb-এর base form ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.question: Choose the right interrogative of the following sentence: Your father came home last night’ [SABAS][]
options: Had your father came home last night?
Did your father come home last night?
Have your father come home last night?
Was your father come home last night?
questions.explanation: Past Indefinite Tense-এর প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্যে 'Did' বসে এবং verb-এর base form (come) ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.question: Choose the correct interrogative form of the following sentence. He married to the beautiful girl. [SABAS][]
options: Was he married to the beautiful girl?
Did he married to the beautiful girl?
Did he marry to the beautiful girl?
Had he married to the beautiful girl?
questions.explanation: Past Indefinite Tense-এ প্রশ্নবোধক করতে 'Did' ব্যবহৃত হয় এবং মূল verb-এর base form (marry) বসে।

questions.question: Choose the correct interrogative. [তুমি কোন বইটা পড়তেছো?] [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: WH-Question এর পর auxiliary verb (are) এবং এরপর subject (you) বসে।

questions.question: Choose the correct interrogative sentence. [আনিসের বয়স কত?] [SABAS][]
options: What is the age of Anis?
How the age of Anis is?
questions.explanation: কারো বয়স জানতে 'How old is...' গঠনটি সবচেয়ে প্রচলিত ও সঠিক।

questions.question: All love flower. (Interrogative) [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: Affirmative বাক্যে 'All/Everyone' থাকলে Interrogative করার সময় 'Who + auxiliary + not' ব্যবহার করতে হয়।

questions.question: Everybody knows this. (Interrogative) [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: Affirmative বাক্যে 'Everybody' থাকলে Interrogative করার সময় 'Who + auxiliary + not' ব্যবহার করতে হয়।

questions.question: Everybody hates a liar. (Interrogative) [SABAS][]
options: Who does not hates a liar?
Who does not hate a liar?
questions.explanation: Everybody-এর পরিবর্তে 'Who + does not' এবং hate-এর base form (hate) বসে।

questions.question: What is the best interrogative form of the sentence? ‘Everybody wants to be rich.’ [SABAS][]
options: Does not everybody want to be rich?
Who does not want to be rich?
Why not everybody wants to be rich?
questions.explanation: Everybody-এর পরিবর্তে 'Who does not' এবং wants-এর base form (want) বসে।

questions.question: ‘Nobody wishes to be unhappy.’ (Interrogative) [SABAS][]
options: Who does not wish to be unhappy?
Does nobody wish to be unhappy?
questions.explanation: Negative বাক্যে 'Nobody/None' থাকলে Interrogative করার সময় শুধুমাত্র 'Who' বসে।

questions.question: ‘None can do this’ এর interrogative form কি হবে? [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: None-এর পরিবর্তে 'anyone' এবং auxiliary verb-কে বাক্যের শুরুতে বসিয়ে interrogative করা যায়।

questions.question: What is the negative- interrogative form of ‘I have been reading’? [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: Negative-interrogative করার সময় auxiliary verb-এর সাথে not যুক্ত হয়। Subject-এর পরে not বসলে তা পূর্ণরূপ হয়।

questions.question: We are proud of our freedom fighters. (Interrogative) [SABAS][]
options: Are we proud of our freedom fighters?
Are we not proud of our freedom fighters?
Are not we proud of our freedom fighters?
Don't we proud of our freedom fighters?
questions.explanation: বাক্যে auxiliary verb (are) থাকলে তার সাথে not যোগ করে negative-interrogative করা হয়েছে।

questions.question: She cooks rice. (Make it negative-interrogative) [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: Present Indefinite Tense-এ 'Does' দিয়ে প্রশ্ন শুরু হয় এবং negative করার জন্য subject-এর পরে 'not' বসে।

questions.question: He went home. (Make it negative-interrogative) [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: Past Indefinite Tense-এ 'Did' দিয়ে প্রশ্ন শুরু হয় এবং verb-এর base form (go) বসে।

questions.question: Which one is Imperative sentence? [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: যে বাক্য দিয়ে আদেশ, উপদেশ বা অনুরোধ বোঝায় তাকে Imperative sentence বলে।

questions.question: Which one is the imperative sentence? [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: যে বাক্যের শুরুতে সরাসরি verb বসে আদেশ, অনুরোধ বা উপদেশ বোঝায়, তাকে Imperative sentence বলে।

questions.question: A sentence that expresses command, forbids, request and advice is called – sentence. [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: আদেশ (command), নিষেধ (forbid), অনুরোধ (request) বা উপদেশ (advice) প্রকাশকারী বাক্যকে Imperative sentence বলে।

questions.question: “Please bring me a cup of tea.” What kind of sentence is this? [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: এই বাক্যটি অনুরোধ (request) বোঝাচ্ছে, তাই এটি একটি Imperative sentence।

questions.question: Do not laugh at the poor. [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: এটি একটি নিষেধসূচক বাক্য, যা Imperative sentence-এর অন্তর্ভুক্ত।

questions.question: Identify the imperative sentence. [SABAS][]
options: It has been raining since morning.
questions.explanation: Stand up বাক্যটি একটি আদেশ বা নির্দেশ বোঝাচ্ছে, যা Imperative sentence।

questions.question: What type of sentence ‘Pay tribute to the memory of a national hero’ is? [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: এটি একটি উপদেশমূলক বাক্য, যা Imperative sentence।

questions.question: We should love our country. (Imperative) [SABAS][]
options: We may not hate our country.
questions.explanation: Assertive sentence-এর subject 'We' (1st person) হলে Imperative করার সময় 'Let + subject-এর objective form + verb' বসে।

questions.explanation: আদেশ, উপদেশ বা অনুরোধ বোঝালে তাকে Imperative sentence বলে। 'Be quiet and listen to my words' একটি সরাসরি আদেশ।

questions.question: ‘None should deny the truth.’ (Affirmative) [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: None-এর বিপরীত Everybody এবং deny-এর বিপরীত admit ব্যবহার করে Affirmative করা হয়েছে।

questions.question: He did not miss the opportunity. বাক্যটির Interrogative form- [SABAS][]
options: Had he not missed the opportunity?
Did he not miss the opportunity?
questions.explanation: Negative sentence-কে Interrogative করার সময় negative উঠে যায়। তাই 'Did he miss...' সঠিক।

questions.question: Choose the best interrogative form of ‘Everyone hates acid-throwing’ [SABAS][]
options: Is there anyone who can who can hate acid-throwing?
questions.explanation: Everyone যুক্ত বাক্যকে Interrogative করার সময় 'Does anyone...' ব্যবহার করতে হয়।

questions.question: ‘May our cricket team win the ‘World Cup’. Change into an assertive sentence [SABAS][]
options: I wish our cricket team to win the ‘World Cup’
I wish that our cricket team wins the ‘World Cup’.
I wish our cricket team could win the ‘World Cup’.
I wish our cricket team can win the ‘World Cup’
questions.explanation: Optative sentence-কে Assertive করার সময় 'I wish' যোগ করতে হয় এবং verb-এর past form (could) ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.question: How beautiful the garden is! (Make it assertive) [SABAS][]
options: It is a very beautiful garden.
The beauty of the garden is really nice.
questions.explanation: Exclamatory-কে Assertive করতে Subject (The garden) + verb (is) + very + adjective (beautiful) গঠন ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।

questions.question: All must submit to destiny. (Make it negative) [SABAS][]
options: Everybody should accept what destiny fixes for them.
questions.explanation: All-এর পরিবর্তে 'No one' এবং must submit-এর সমার্থক 'escape' ব্যবহার করে Negative করা হয়েছে।

questions.question: Which one is a negative interrogative sentence? [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: যে Interrogative sentence-এ negative (not) থাকে, তাকে negative interrogative বলে। 'Do they not work?' সঠিক গঠন।

questions.question: Health is wealth. Change it into Interrogative without changing meaning. [SABAS][]
questions.explanation: Affirmative-কে Interrogative করতে negative (Isn't) যোগ করতে হয়।

questions.question: Identify the imperative sentence: [SABAS][]
options: What a wonderful picture it is!
Get some cold water from the fridge.
The bought some utensils from the shop.
questions.explanation: আদেশসূচক বাক্য হওয়ায় 'Get some cold water from the fridge' একটি Imperative sentence।
